description: Copy one ad squad (optionally with its ads) into a target campaign. Created PAUSED. Budgets are scaled by budget_scale and must stay within the configured limits. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name: snap_copy_adsquad
